comment: Read from src/Filter.cpp and src/blocks/FilterBlock.hpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1. The cutoff knob spans 20Hz to 20480Hz, exactly ten octaves, which the maker's own comment at Filter.cpp:34 says is required for the volt-per-octave CV scaling. The cutoff is also clamped to a fifth of the oversampled rate (Filter.cpp:92), so it cannot reach the top of the knob at low oversampling settings. The eighteen mode names are at FilterBlock.hpp:65 to 82 and the module starts on the ninth of them, the two-pole Sallen-Key lowpass.
